scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 29 supersedes attempt 28 after a full real-world pass over all 36 original user GLBs and the Games 3D layout. The exact production source 40962b0e576eb4dc81799a4451c492b05823cf65 is green across Platform Models, Unified Cursor, Performance, Download Refresh and GameCube. Preserve the cleaned single-owner architecture: HuymaierPlatformModels.ps1 is presentation-base only, HuymaierLivePlatformModels.ps1 V3 is GLB/Viewport3D plus context-aware full-screen-viewer helpers only, and HuymaierUser3DModels.ps1 V6 is the sole Games 3D presentation owner. In 3D Models mode use two compact horizontal shelves instead of the oversized V5 hero presentation: Providers on the top shelf and Consoles on the bottom shelf, each retaining its own selection. Provider and console classification must use actual platform metadata/storefront identification, not row position. Keep the compact V6 dimensions and reject the retired V5 470x390/302px hero-card layout. Preserve original platform action IDs and frozen selection/open behavior; Left/Right stays within the focused shelf, Up/Down can move between shelves/normal content, A/Cross opens the selected platform, and X/Square opens the full-screen model viewer. Resolve GLBs with shelf context: the Xbox PC provider must not consume the Original Xbox hardware Xbox.glb; it may use an explicit Xbox App.glb or Microsoft Xbox App.glb if supplied, while the bottom-shelf Original Xbox continues to resolve the user's Xbox.glb. Full textured GLB residency must remain bounded to at most four scenes total across both shelves: focused shelf selected plus immediate left/right neighbors and the unfocused shelf selected; farther models restore normal icons and pending out-of-neighborhood loads are discarded. Shelf animation is a slow Y-axis turntable/microwave-plate rotation using Viewport3D transforms only and must never call Render-Page. Background library, artwork, emulator-count, native-console-count and provider polling may update data in memory but must not destroy/recreate the mounted Games 3D shelves; redundant same-page refreshes are deferred while V6 shelves are active. The full 36-model compatibility pass is authoritative: support embedded PNG/JPEG base/diffuse textures, multiple UV sets, KHR_texture_transform offset/scale/rotation/texCoord, sampler clamp/repeat/mirrored-repeat behavior, alphaMode including BLEND, emissive textures plus KHR_materials_emissive_strength, KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness, KHR_materials_specular and KHR_materials_clearcoat approximations, KHR_materials_unlit, material factors, double-sided materials, and per-document embedded-image caching. WPF remains an approximation for advanced PBR/normal/metallic-roughness/occlusion lighting, but visible base/diffuse/emissive/material appearance must not be silently replaced by neutral gray where supported GLB data exists. Five audited originals intentionally contain zero image textures—Playstation 5.glb, Sega Logo.glb, Sony Playstation Vita.glb, XBOX 360.glb and Xbox.glb—and must retain their authored material colors rather than being treated as texture failures. User-owned models remain persistent in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Huymaier Console\3D Models or the optional portable folder using the same original 36 filenames, with zero bundled GLBs in normal release bytes. Keep the model-size setting under Settings > Customization; V6 retains the user-facing 50-200 slider but the live renderer uses the proven perspective-safe bounding-diameter normalization with the same strict 70-percent maximum visual probe. Source and staged gates must build an embedded red/blue GLB using KHR_texture_transform, sampler wrapping, alpha BLEND, emissiveTexture and KHR_materials_emissive_strength; they must prove full-texture mode, material/texture/image diagnostics, both texture colors, 45-degree turntable rotation, and exactly zero edge pixels before and after rotation at maximum tested shelf framing. Preserve the AST protected-automatic-variable audit across shipped PowerShell, zero reserved $Host/$PID collisions, native-only unified browser cursor with serialized PID/GUID atomic state writes, retired atlas/static-preview/generated-model payload absence, exactly one x64 HuymaierLiveModel3D.dll, and zero bundled GLBs. Preserve all previously proven GameCube, Downloads, Performance, native streaming, Sony Raw-HID, Game Bar, Wii/Dolphin, provider concurrency, installer rollback/tamper, Steam/Nintendo ownership, shelf artwork persistence, Downloads history behavior and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Upload only if exact-source revalidation, x64 FSE build, release-shaped package build, installer/integrity failure injection, stabilization, staged native cursor/streaming/GameCube, staged V6 compact dual-shelf material/render gates, active-download library stability, Steam owned-library behavior and final-hash verification all pass together.
